_about: Module definitions for the logistics group (A3 starter kit: Tank, Funnel). Shape: id, name, kind (the behaviour
script in scripts/machines/), size [w, h] in cells, wall (casing thickness), faces [{type pixel|power|mech|signal,
dir up|down|left|right, at (middle along the wall), w, name}], cost [stone, glimmer, obsidian, water, power], blurb,
anchored (bolted in place: it holds still until something drives it), pass {face, rate} (units a scan moved out of
that face into what's joined there), params (the behaviour's own numbers).

modules.name: Tank
modules.blurb: Holds what the Excavator below it digs, packed four cells to a slot of its hollow. Hooks onto a Winch at the top and empties through a Funnel when it docks. Tank Size research makes it hold more.

modules.name: Funnel
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. A Tank docked under it empties into it, and what it takes goes into the Hub's stockpile.
